headline: Decision infrastructure for high-consideration purchases in Turkey
elevator: Consumers make ₺500K–₺3M decisions with fragmented listings and biased sellers.
isteBul unifies fit, TCO, finance load, and partner execution in one transparent workflow.
Revenue is hybrid: Pro subscription + partner lead economics — both instrumented in production.

problem.summary: High-consideration buyers lack a neutral decision layer between classifieds and single-product banks.
painPoints: Listings optimize for inventory, not total cost of ownership
Finance calculators are product-biased, not multi-offer neutral
AI chat tools invent prices — no CRM or partner closure loop
problem.buyerQuote: I need to know if this car fits my budget and life — not just the monthly payment the dealer quoted.

solution.summary: Rule-based decision engine + explainable scores + partner dispatch for execution.

pillars.title: Decide
pillars.detail: Multi-factor match, confidence tiers, TCO profiles

pillars.title: Explain
pillars.detail: LLM narrates deterministic numbers — cannot override scores

pillars.title: Close
pillars.detail: Qualified leads → HMAC webhooks → CRM → outcome feedback

solution.demoHook: Live auto wizard on istebul.com/auto — scores update as inputs change.

vision.threeYear: Category leader for decision intelligence in TR; 3+ verticals at production parity; outcome graph from closed deals.
vision.category: Decision infrastructure — not classifieds, not a generic AI wrapper.

whyNow: AI trust crisis — buyers demand explainable numbers
Finance margin pressure — partners need scored intent, not form spam
Product is live and instrumented — weekly investor exports, not slideware
whyUs: Deterministic scoring IP in production (decision-consultant, scoring-explainability)
Partner flywheel: dispatch → win data → calibration
Platform roadmap: 8 verticals on shared engine + locale registry

milestones: 2+ signed partner LOIs with CPL bands
Pro MRR growth with trial→paid instrumentation
Live market data feed for auto catalog (1 exclusive source)
